meta.name: Canonical high-income physician household
meta.description: Synthetic, representative household used to rank financial decisions by effect size. Two 35-year-olds, two years out of training; household gross ~$410k, ~$270,000 net; $150,000 invested; real income held flat. All figures are real 2026 dollars, net of tax. Savings, student loans, housing and education are grid dimensions.
